findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - A long title is shortened in its Needs you card. The test accepts the exact title anywhere on the page, and the stopped fix in the fixture also has a Building card. That card satisfies the lookup while the shortened Needs you title is never inspected. The overlap check also samples only the title’s centre, so a neighbouring region can cover its edge without failing the test. These leave the previous Needs you and overlap proof gaps open.
findings.title: Gate: tests/test_board_first_screen_reads_whole.py

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: the test must look at the Needs you card itself, and the Stories rail titles must wrap whole at every width

why: On the board's first screen, card titles are cut off so two cards look the same, a stalled part has no idle time on its card, 74 stories show the placeholder "A story with missing state" even though their plan files have real titles, and the Stories rail shows "unknown" where no owner is set.
